supporting_observations.claim: WS-EBROOKS-01 made repeated connections through 10.54.20.30 on port 8080, with observed starts from 13:31:08 through 14:14:30 UTC. These records describe HTTP connections to a proxy; they do not identify the requested destination or establish that the traffic was HTTPS.

The observed proxy connections recur at roughly several-minute intervals, broadly consistent with the alert's periodicity, but the available records do not attribute them to a process or show what service they accessed.

At 14:14 UTC, several additional proxy connections occurred close together; some had substantially larger response volumes than the earlier listed sessions. The records do not establish what was transferred or whether it was related to the periodic connections.
